This page describes community challenges and events for *Fallout 76*. The following topics may be enabled on a set rotation, only during specific times of the year or to coincide with narrative update releases.

- Project Clean Appalachia (2019)
- Mystery Items (2020)
- Fortifying ATLAS (2020)
- Spread the Love (2021)
- The Coming Storm (2021)
- Anniversary Mystery Item (2022)
- Call to Axe-ion (2022)
- Cryptid Hunt (2023)
- Summer C.A.M.P. Challenge (2023)
- Birthday Challenge (2023)
- Burning Love (2024)
- Uncharted Lands (2024)
- The Science of Love (2025)
- PROTECT Protocol (2026)

- Bombs Drop (2020 and 2021)
- Deathclaw Easter Egg Hunt (2019 and 2021)

Main article: Fallout 76 seasons#Mini-seasons

Beginning in 2025, *Fallout 76* began transitioning away from the format of one-off community events handled through challenges, and instead began utilizing "mini-seasons," similar to the seasons system. For more information on mini-seasons, see here.

- **Gameplay:**

- **Double-Mutation Daily Ops** - Daily Ops enemies are empowered with a third mutation. All currency rewards are doubled and may be obtained repeatedly.
- **Hunt for the Treasure Hunter** - Enemies in the overworld have a chance to be replaced a Treasure Hunter, which are special mole miners with a beeping backpack. They drop exclusive mole miner pails and Legendary items upon death.
- **Public Worlds** - The public Fallout World is rotated every month.
- **Mutated public events** - A random mutated event will occur at the top of every hour.

- **Special vendors:**

- **Minerva's Emporium** - Available every Monday at 12:00 PM ET thru Wednesday at 12:00 PM ET, Minerva and her caravan tent will appear at either The Crater, Fort Atlas or Foundation. She accepts gold bullion in exchange for her rotating selection of rare, discounted plans.
- **Minerva's Big Sale** - Minerva offers three pools of plans rather than one.
- **Mystery Pick** - fully randomized legendary item at Purveyor Murmrgh's
- **Purveyor Legendary Sale** - 25% off discount at Purveyor Murmrgh's

- **Currency events:**

- **Caps-O'-Plenty** - double the daily Caps from vendors
- **Scrip Surplus** - double the daily Scrip from legendary exchange machines
- **Gold Rush** - double the daily gold bullion from turning in treasury notes
- **Double XP** - double XP from every action
- **Triple XP** - triple XP from every action
